items.topic: Validate gaps yourself, not by delegating to subagents
items.claim: Agent launched 21 gap-validator subagents (model @free) to validate the 420 mined gaps.
items.fact: Operator: 'You vladiate not suabgents' (You validate, not subagents). Validation of mined gaps must be done by the main agent itself (mechanical code checks plus own review), not delegated to subagents; the subagents were aborted.

items.topic: Gap-mining pipeline (packs -> miners -> validation -> report)
items.fact: Gap mining ran 60 packs (P01-P34 platform, S01-S26 sessions) via gap-miner subagents (model @free) using miner-platform.md / miner-sessions.md, writing target/gap-mining/out/<ID>.json. Rounds of ~20 parallel subagents. Consolidated to all_gaps.json (420 gaps: area model 94, backend 89, deployment 59, domain 38, frontend 36, security 33, integration 31, testing 24, cli 16; target agent-docs 261, best-practices 117, model-blueprints 42). Final: 324 validated gaps in 72 themes, 16 already covered, 79 not needed by app developers, 1 unverifiable. Output: openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb/knowledge-gaps-report.md.

items.topic: Subagent JSON output can be invalid; always json.load all outputs
items.fact: Miner S09 wrote invalid JSON (JSONDecodeError: Expecting ',' delimiter) because of unescaped quotes; the agent deleted the file and re-ran it with a prompt addition 'valid JSON; escape quotes inside strings'. Verify every subagent output with a python json.load loop and re-run missing IDs.

items.topic: Mechanical validation of gap evidence: matcher pitfalls
items.claim: Initial mechanical check flagged 142 gaps as evidence failures.
items.fact: Failures were matcher faults: session evidence is cited by short name (e.g. 'judo-cli-sessions 2026-08-05T13-50 : [U] "..."') and some file citations lack line numbers. After broadening matching (normalized text, 6-word sliding windows over session files, path without line) 419 of 420 gaps had verifiable evidence; only P24-01 (judo-tatami-jsl viewTableDeclaration path) was broken. Auto-clustering of duplicates by token overlap merged almost nothing (409 clusters), so manual theme review was needed.

items.topic: Check catalog coverage before calling something missing
items.fact: Catalog-coverage check: grep a corpus of agent-docs/best-practices/model-blueprints md (565 files) with 3+ terms per gap plus targeted regexes (e.g. optimistic|__version, signed identifier changes, BooleanFilter, JdbcTemplate, S3/minio, health check). Distinguish 'missing' from 'covered but not findable' (16 gaps covered, a findability issue; e.g. unsaved changes warning in frontend/hooks/navigation-and-access.md, !now() default in best-practices/model/default-value-patterns.md, partial-update mask in best-practices/backend/mutable-entity-update-pattern.md).

items.topic: Tool pitfalls: read/bash output stubs and kb guard
items.fact: The kb read-discipline guard fires after repeated source searching without kb consult ('[kb] Repeated source searching, still no kb consult. Stop and run kb_search ... now'); run kb_search / kb get before continuing. Also ctx_execute reports context-mode outdated v1.0.169 vs v2.1.4.

items.topic: JQL temporal/date-time functions
items.claim: Not documented: current_date/current_timestamp/current_time, constructors, !extract, !difference, millisecond conversions, timestamp arithmetic.
items.fact: Gap P05-1: JQL temporal functions exist in judo-meta-expression and are undocumented in the catalog.

items.topic: Environment variable categories SYSTEM & PARAMETER and typed/measured env vars
items.claim: Only PRINCIPAL/ACTOR env var categories are documented.
items.fact: JQL environment variables also have SYSTEM and PARAMETER categories and typed/measured env vars (judo-meta-expression).

items.topic: Measured literal syntax and duration addability
items.fact: Measured literal syntax is measure#unit; duration addability rules: MONTH/YEAR durations are non-addable; a default-duration-measure is required.

items.topic: JQL collection functions and boolean aggregators
items.fact: Undocumented: head/tail/heads/tails, !join, anyTrue/allTrue/anyFalse/allFalse; aggregation type constraints and round(scale).

items.topic: JQL string variants and ternary operator
items.claim: lpad/rpad/ltrim/rtrim/capitalize/ilike and the JQL ternary '? :' / switch-expression typing are used in best practices but never documented.
items.fact: Document these JQL functions and typing rules.

items.topic: JCL action-language syntax reference
items.claim: operation.md only mentions JCL in passing; body is a Script row.
items.fact: JCL (JUDO Control Language) needs a reference: declarations, statements, if/for/while/return, new/delete/unset, reference-set +=, create/multi-create, mutation/immutable, whitespace-sensitive calls, noDanglingNavigation. Source docs: documentation@3eec62f:docs/modules/ROOT/pages/user-guide/application_modeling/04_jcl.adoc.

items.topic: Signed identifier cannot be minted by client/server code
items.fact: The runtime only mints a __signedIdentifier while serving a REST response; there is no reachable plain mint API. Code needing a ticket's __signedIdentifier cannot create one itself. Signed ids can differ from locally stored ones when the JUDO side updates the entity (signed id changes after update). Propose new agent-docs/backend/signed-identifiers.md, linked from frontend/advanced-patterns.md.

items.topic: Generated relation-setter DAOs NPE on null
items.fact: Generated DAO relation setters (e.g. setErrorReplacement(entity, relatedObject)) call relatedObject.identifier() unconditionally, so passing null throws NullPointerException; unset must be used instead.

items.topic: Querying enumeration-typed relation can return raw Integer (ClassCastException)
items.fact: Enum-typed relation queries can return raw Integer (ordinal) causing ClassCastException; document as known issue (also REST wire contract: enums are ordinals).

items.topic: Mapped vs unmapped transfer-object DAO API surface
items.fact: Generated DAO interface emits full CRUD (create/createAll with/without Mask, getById/existsById/getAll/countAll/delete, query(), per-relation create/set/unset/add/remove/range) only on mapped, non-abstract types, gated behind self.isMapped (plus relation allowed-operations). Also payload helper has Map.of-style overloads for 1-20 pairs, getAs(Class,String), getAsCollectionPayload, getAsPayload.

items.topic: REST operation URL suffixes and response DTO metadata
items.fact: REST operation path suffixes: ~create, ~list, ~range, ~upload-token, etc. Response DTO metadata fields: __identifier, __signedIdentifier, __version, __deleteable, __entityType, __referenceId. Wire conversion: enums as ordinals, binaries as filestore tokens.

items.topic: Query-customizer filter operator codes and query-mask wire syntax
items.fact: Document filter operator codes and query mask wire syntax; classes QueryMaskStringParser, error INVALID_QUERY_MASK.

items.topic: Platform EXPORT operation and Excel Export SPI
items.fact: Platform has an EXPORT operation and Excel Export SPI: JxlsExport, UnsupportedExportImpl, bound in JudoDefaultModule.

items.topic: Boot-time initializer operations
items.fact: EOperations annotated as initializer run automatically on model boot (InitScriptExecutor, InitScriptsCompleted, targetDatasourceModelName).

items.topic: BasicApplication configuration keys and deferred startup
items.fact: BasicApplication config keys (e.g. jaxrs.resource.components) and deferred startup behaviour need documenting.

items.topic: Backend error code to i18n key mapping with English fallback
items.fact: Every business error (e.g. DEFECT_TICKET_IS_NOT_DELETABLE) needs a SimpleParameterTemplater-based i18n key with English fallback.

items.topic: Jasypt-encrypted config values and PAX-JDBC passwords
items.fact: Config can embed secrets as password=ENC(encrypted_password); the org.jasypt.encryption.StringEncryptor OSGi service (karaf-jasypt-support, osgi-encryption) decrypts; passwords can be encrypted with a Karaf command and replaced in DBCP2 config files.

items.topic: OSGi model bundle packaging and DS unit testing
items.fact: Models are packaged as OSGi bundles with a Judo-Models manifest header (ModelBundleTracker). OSGi DS components can be unit-tested without a container using MockOsgi (ComponentContext, BeanUtil setReferences).

items.topic: judo-cli (judo-model-cli) pitfalls
items.fact: judo_cli cannot create reference-derived UI elements (link columns) or disambiguate duplicate FQNs (xmiId); TabularReferenceFieldCreateInput has no name field; non-interactive alias, stale jar and wrong model in session pitfalls; ESM version pins (judo-meta-esm-version), jar redeploy, read upstream docs at pinned commit via git show <sha>:docs/commands/<cmd>.md; mvnw -f application/model/pom.xml -N validate. CLI knowledge is owned by the judo-model-cli skill (report section 5). Top High theme: 'judo-model-cli usage the catalog must teach or link' (22 sessions).

items.topic: Link columns/actions on row table never generated
items.fact: judo-tatami-jsl-jsl2ui viewTableDeclaration epsilon transformation does not generate link columns/actions on row tables. Evidence path was broken (only gap whose evidence failed verification).

items.topic: Gap report scope: what is missing vs wrong, priority rules
items.fact: knowledge-gaps-report.md covers what is MISSING; catalog-update-report.md covers what is WRONG. Priority: High = seen in >=3 sessions or >=6 independent findings; Medium = 1-2 sessions or >=3 findings; Low = rest. Counts: agent-docs 25/18/6, best-practices 8/7/0, model-blueprints 6/1/0, cli 1/0/0 (High/Med/Low). Missing blueprints (inspection fault registry/ticketing, offer pricing, job sheet->work report->certificate, partner-scoped multi-role users, offline mobile ingest, typed media attachments, retention) come from one project and must be generalised before becoming blueprints.

items.topic: Top missing-knowledge themes (High priority)
items.fact: High themes by session count: judo-model-cli usage (22); inspection fault registry/ticketing; model changes that break generated/custom frontend code; generated DAO/SDK surprises; UI model values that break the generator; offline-first mobile ingest (localId idempotency, two-stage upload, change stamps); binary upload/download two-phase token flow; SYSTEM/non-principal actors (exposure, transfer-object closure, realm); multi-module build order and stale artifacts; DAO read/write performance (seek, batching, eager owned relations); enforce rules server-side not only in UI; E2E methodology (baseline dump, real-UI first, time budget); model workflow gates as derived predicates over status.
